description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeObject' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform'. It primarily provides a 'transform' method to set a default 'type' attribute for object tags, specifically supporting Flash objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeObject
classes.description: A class that sets default type for object elements, supporting Flash objects.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Sets a default 'type' attribute to 'application/x-shockwave-flash' if none is provided.
